prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury attorney for every car-accident case in Chicago — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash, the severity of injuries, whether your case will likely settle or go to trial, and your personal preferences (communication style, fee terms, local courtroom experience). I can help you find the best fit. Below are practical next steps, selection criteria, and a few well-known Chicago firms you can start with.

What to look for
- Experience with car-accident cases (not just general PI): recovery for medical bills, lost wages, pain & suffering.  
- Trial experience and a record of significant settlements/verdicts (important if insurer won’t offer fair value).  
- Local courtroom knowledge in Cook County — judges, defense lawyers, insurance adjusters.  
- Clear fee structure (most work on contingency — no fee unless you recover).  
- Good client reviews and peer recognition (AV Preeminent/Martindale-Hubbell, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers).  
- Responsive communication and willingness to explain strategy and timelines.

Reputable Chicago personal-injury firms to consider (examples to research)
- Clifford Law Offices  
- Corboy & Demetrio  
- Levin & Perconti  
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C.  
- Power Rogers & Smith

(These firms are well-known in Chicago for serious personal-injury work; verify current attorney availability and recent results.)

Questions to ask in a consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the results?  
- Who exactly will handle my case (attorney vs. paralegal)?  
- What is your fee and expense policy?  
- Do you take cases to trial or mainly settle?  
- How will you communicate with me and how often?  
- What is a realistic range of outcomes?

What to bring to an initial consult
- Police report, photos of the accident/vehicle/injuries, medical records/bills, insurance info, names of witnesses, dates you missed work.

If you want, tell me:
- ZIP code or neighborhood in Chicago, a brief summary of the crash and injuries, and whether you’ve spoken to insurers. I’ll put together a short, tailored list of attorneys/firms and next actions you can take.
